name: Lakeway
seo_title: Lakeway Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 5 Events, 3 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Lakeway, TX: Lights On at City Hall, the Trail of Lights, a toy drive Christmas show, a free Nutcracker and a Lake Travis boat parade.
lede: Lakeway celebrates Christmas around City Hall and the Activity Center: a Lights On ceremony and a Trail of Lights behind City Hall, community shows that collect toys for children in need, and lighted boats on Lake Travis.
celebrates: The City of Lakeway starts the season with its Lights On ceremony, then leaves a Trail of Lights glowing behind City Hall on Lohmans Crossing through the end of the year. The Lakeway Activity Center on Cross Creek becomes the town's holiday stage, with the Lakeway Sings Family Christmas Show, which asks for a new toy instead of a ticket, and a free Nutcracker presented by the City of Lakeway Arts Committee. Families also use the city's Light Up Lakeway map to find decorated houses, and on the water, Lakeway Resort and Spa hosts a lighted boat parade on Lake Travis.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Lakeway held its Lights On ceremony on Friday, December 5. A week later, on December 12, the city showed the movie Elf in the City Hall parking lot, inviting families to come in costume, sip hot cocoa and write letters to Santa. The city's December newsletter reminded residents that the Trail of Lights behind City Hall stayed open through the end of the year, and it pointed families to the online Light Up Lakeway holiday lights map.
facts: Lakeway began as a ranch. In 1962 three men from the Gulfmont Hotel Company, G. Flint Sawtelle, John H. Crooker Jr. and Lee Blocker, took an option on Jack Josey's 2,700 acre ranch on Lake Travis. They borrowed the name from the company's Fairway Motor Hotel in McAllen. Lot sales began on May 30, 1963, and the Lakeway Inn and Marina opened that July. Residents voted to incorporate in 1974 and chose Newt Herndon as the first mayor. The Lakeway Sings Family Christmas Show reaches its 26th year in 2026.
trains: Lakeway sits on the hills above Lake Travis, well away from any rail line. The closest passenger trains are Capital MetroRail's Red Line, which runs between Leander and Downtown Austin with a station at Lakeline in northwest Austin, and Amtrak's Texas Eagle, which stops at the Austin station. The best train outing for Lakeway families is the Austin Steam Train Association in Cedar Park, which runs vintage trains into the Hill Country and a Christmas North Pole Flyer each season.
train_links: Vintage train rides from Cedar Park, including the Hill Country Flyer and the North Pole Flyer at Christmas.
traditions: The City of Lakeway switches on its holiday lights at City Hall in early December.
A lighted walking trail behind City Hall stays open through the end of the year.
A community chorus show at the Activity Center where a new toy for the Green Santa Program is the price of admission.
The City of Lakeway Arts Committee brings Nutcracker excerpts to a free community stage.
The city publishes an online map of decorated homes for families who want to drive around and look at lights.
In 2025 the city showed Elf in the City Hall parking lot, with hot cocoa and letters to Santa.
kidfact: Lakeway was a ranch before it was a town. The men who built it named it after a hotel called the Fairway in McAllen, near the Mexican border.
faq: Where is the Lakeway Trail of Lights?

The Trail of Lights runs behind Lakeway City Hall at 1102 Lohmans Crossing. The city opens it in early December and, according to its 2025 newsletter, keeps it lit through the end of the year, so families can walk it on any evening after the Lights On ceremony.
What is Lights On in Lakeway?

Lights On is the City of Lakeway's ceremony that switches on the holiday lights at City Hall. In 2025 it took place on Friday, December 5. It marks the start of the season in Lakeway and opens the Trail of Lights behind City Hall.
How does the Lakeway Sings Christmas show work?

Lakeway Sings, a community chorus, puts on a Family Christmas Show at the Lakeway Activity Center each December. Instead of selling tickets, it asks each guest for a new, unwrapped toy, which goes to LTlov's Green Santa Program for children in need around Lake Travis.
Is there a Christmas lights map for Lakeway?

Yes. The City of Lakeway runs Light Up Lakeway, an online map of homes decorated for the holidays. It is a good way to plan a drive around town on a December evening after a walk on the Trail of Lights.

Lakeway began in 1962 when three Gulfmont Hotel Company men took an option on Jack Josey's 2,700 acre ranch on Lake Travis. Lot sales started in May 1963, the Lakeway Inn and Marina opened that July, and residents voted to incorporate in 1974.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Lakeway for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from Friday, December 4 through Sunday, December 13, with Lights On at Lakeway City Hall (Friday, December 4), the Boat Parade at Lakeway Resort and Spa (Saturday, December 5) and the Lakeway Sings North Pole Rock and Roll Family Christmas Show (Sunday, December 6). New in this update: the Boat Parade at Lakeway Resort and Spa (Saturday, December 5), Santa at Pikopye's Town (Sunday, December 6) and The Nutcracker with Metamorphosis Dance at the Lakeway Activity Center (Sunday, December 13). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Texas Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Lakeway families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Austin, which covers the Austin Trail of Lights, the Zilker Holiday Tree, the North Pole Flyer train ride and dozens of free family events across the area.

What Rally found in Lakeway

  • 5 family events, 3 of them free
  • Meet Santa: Santa at Pikopye's Town, Sunday, December 6, at 10 am and 1 pm
  • Tree lightings and parades: the Boat Parade at Lakeway Resort and Spa, Saturday, December 5, with the parade at 6 pm, and Lights On at Lakeway City Hall, Friday, December 4
  • Also on the list: a family Christmas show and a Nutcracker at the Lakeway Activity Center
  • Season: December 4 to December 13, 2026
  • Every date checked on the host's own site on Nov 25
